meta.title: क्या शामिल है
meta.description: आयुर्वेदिक उत्पाद पर कौन से बौद्धिक संपदा और नियामक प्रश्न लागू होते हैं, और वे कैसे जुड़ते हैं।

heading: आयुर्वेद के बौद्धिक संपदा और नियामक परिदृश्य को समझना
standfirst: आयुर्वेदिक उत्पाद के विभिन्न भाग अलग-अलग प्रश्न उठाते हैं। यह पृष्ठ बताता है कि कौन सा क्या है।

pending.title: इस पृष्ठ पर अभी कुछ भी स्रोत-आधारित नहीं है
pending.body: कोई भी दस्तावेज़ शामिल नहीं किया गया है, इसलिए नीचे दिया गया प्रत्येक बयान लंबित के रूप में चिह्नित है।

marker.pending: लंबित स्रोत {{number}}: {{title}}। अभी तक पुनर्प्राप्त नहीं किया गया।

sourceList.heading: यह अनुभाग उद्धृत करेगा
sourceList.gap: (उद्धृत करने के लिए कोई साधन नहीं — यह अनुपस्थिति दर्शाता है)

distinction.heading: दो प्रश्न, और वे क्यों जुड़े हैं
distinction.ipBody: मैं इसमें अधिकारों को कैसे सुरक्षित या समझूँ? यह विशिष्टता के बारे में है।
distinction.regBody: इसे बनाने, बेचने या विज्ञापित करने से पहले मुझे क्या करना चाहिए? यह अनुमति के बारे में है।
distinction.couplingHeading: आयुर्वेद के लिए, वे एक ही प्रश्न दो बार पूछे गए हैं
distinction.couplingBody: अधिकांश उद्योग इन्हें अलग मान सकते हैं। यहाँ आप नहीं कर सकते, क्योंकि नियामक वर्गीकरण तय करता है कि क्या आईपी उपलब्ध है।
distinction.matrixHeading: प्रत्येक उत्पाद वर्ग क्या खोलता और बंद करता है
distinction.matrixNote: संक्षिप्त विवरण। विस्तृत विवरण उत्तर में आता है।

classical_generic.ip: संरचना प्रलेखित पारंपरिक ज्ञान है, इसलिए वास्तविक रूप से दावा करने योग्य नहीं है। ब्रांड, पैकेजिंग और कलाकृति उपलब्ध हैं।
classical_generic.regulatory: [HI] The classical route, resting on the authoritative texts the drug rules recognise.
classical_generic.abs: [HI] Duties can still attach to the biological resource used, whatever the formulation's status.

patent_proprietary.ip: वास्तव में जो बदला गया था उस पर तर्क संभव है। पारंपरिक आधार बाकी के खिलाफ पूर्व कला के रूप में खड़ा है।
patent_proprietary.regulatory: [HI] Licensed as a patent or proprietary medicine, with conditions of its own.
patent_proprietary.abs: [HI] Duties attach, and they begin to interact with anything you file.

new_non_classical_drug.ip: सबसे व्यापक दायरा। एक नई प्रक्रिया या एक संयोजन जो पहले अज्ञात था, अपने गुणों पर दावा किया जा सकता है।
new_non_classical_drug.regulatory: [HI] The new-drug route, which asks for evidence rather than textual authority.
new_non_classical_drug.abs: [HI] Duties attach, and disclosure of the biological source becomes part of the filing.

phytopharmaceutical.ip: एक शुद्ध या मानकीकृत अंश सबसे अधिक पेटेंट योग्य रूप है, क्योंकि यह पूरे पौधे की तैयारी से सबसे दूर है।
phytopharmaceutical.regulatory: [HI] A route of its own, with data requirements separate from both the classical and the new-drug paths.
phytopharmaceutical.abs: [HI] Duties attach; the resource is usually a named plant, which makes the trigger easy to identify and hard to avoid.

ayurveda_aahar.ip: [HI] Brand, packaging and design. A food cannot be claimed as a medicine, and the composition is rarely claimable.
ayurveda_aahar.regulatory: [HI] The food route, under the food authority rather than the drug regulator.
ayurveda_aahar.abs: [HI] Duties can attach to the resource. Being a food does not remove them.

cosmetic.ip: [HI] Brand, packaging and the design of the article. Composition claims are narrow.
cosmetic.regulatory: [HI] The cosmetic route, which turns on external use for appearance rather than therapeutic effect.
cosmetic.abs: [HI] Duties can attach to the resource, on the same basis as any other use.

rights.heading: अधिकार, एक-एक करके
rights.standfirst: इनमें से प्रत्येक एक अलग प्रश्न का उत्तर देता है।

labels.inAyurveda: How it shows up in Ayurveda
labels.question: A question people actually ask

patents.title: पेटेंट
patents.protects: (पेटेंट) A new invention that is not obvious to someone skilled in the field, for a limited term, in exchange for disclosing how it works.
patents.inAyurveda: Rarely the formulation itself. More often a process, a delivery form, a purified fraction, or a specific combination that does something the individual ingredients were not already known to do.
patents.question: We reformulated a classical preparation — is there anything patentable in it?
patents.doesNot: It does not give you permission to sell: a granted patent and a manufacturing licence are separate and neither implies the other. It does not make a formulation new — documented traditional knowledge is prior art, and an aggregation of known properties is generally not an invention.
patents.jurisdiction: India, with separate filings in every other country you want protection in.

gi.title: भौगोलिक संकेत
gi.protects: (भौगोलिक संकेत) A name identifying goods as coming from a particular place, where a quality, reputation or characteristic is due to that origin.
gi.inAyurveda: Regional herbs and preparations whose character is tied to where they grow, or to how a locality has long made them.
gi.question: Our herb grows only in one district — does that qualify for a geographical indication?
gi.doesNot: It is not owned by one company. A GI is held for a class of producers meeting the specification, so it gives no exclusivity over competitors in the same region, and does not stop anyone outside it making a similar product under another name.
gi.jurisdiction: India. Protection elsewhere is separate and works differently from country to country.

trademarks.title: ट्रेडमार्क
trademarks.protects: (ट्रेडमार्क) A sign that tells a buyer who made the product.
trademarks.inAyurveda: Brand names for Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani products, house marks, and the get-up of a pack.
trademarks.question: Can we register our brand name if it contains a classical formulation name?
trademarks.doesNot: It does not hand you a classical formulation name. A mark merely describing the product will struggle, and other manufacturers need the same classical name for the same preparation. Registration does not license a claim the advertising rules prohibit — mark and claim are judged separately.
trademarks.jurisdiction: India, with separate registration abroad or through an international filing system.

copyright.title: कॉपीराइट
copyright.protects: (कॉपीराइट) Original expression — text, images, artwork, software — not the ideas, facts or methods inside it.
copyright.inAyurveda: Course material, translations and commentaries, packaging artwork, photography, software. The classical texts are long out of copyright; a new translation or commentary is a new work with its own term.
copyright.question: Can we stop someone copying our training material?
copyright.doesNot: It does not protect a formulation, a process, or a treatment protocol. Someone may read your book and make your product.
copyright.jurisdiction: India, with protection in most other countries arising automatically under treaty rather than by registration.

designs.title: डिज़ाइन
designs.protects: (डिज़ाइन) How a manufactured article looks — its shape, configuration, pattern or ornament.
designs.inAyurveda: A bottle, a dispenser, a jar closure, the form of a pack.
designs.question: We designed a distinctive dispenser — can we protect the shape?
designs.doesNot: It does not protect how the article works, and it does not survive publication: showing the design before you apply can destroy the right you were about to register.
designs.jurisdiction: India, with separate filings or an international route abroad.

plantVariety.title: पौधों की किस्म के अधिकार
plantVariety.protects: (पौधों की किस्म के अधिकार) A new plant variety that is distinct from what exists, uniform within itself, and stable across generations.
plantVariety.inAyurveda: Cultivated varieties of medicinal plants developed for yield, potency, or hardiness.
plantVariety.question: We developed a cultivar of a medicinal plant — can we register it?
plantVariety.doesNot: It is not a patent on the plant, and it sits alongside farmers' rights rather than overriding them.
plantVariety.jurisdiction: India, under a regime of its own rather than under the patent system.

tradeSecrets.title: व्यापार रहस्य
tradeSecrets.protects: (व्यापार रहस्य) In India, no standalone statute. Confidential information is held through contract, employment terms and the general law rather than by any registration.
tradeSecrets.inAyurveda: Process know-how, sourcing relationships, standardisation methods — precisely the things a patent application would have to disclose.
tradeSecrets.question: Should we file a patent or keep the process confidential?
tradeSecrets.doesNot: It gives you nothing against independent discovery or reverse engineering, and it is in direct tension with two disclosure obligations: what a patent application must reveal, and what a regulatory dossier must contain.
tradeSecrets.jurisdiction: India — and the absence of a dedicated statute is itself the point, so this section states a gap rather than a regime.

tk.title: पारंपरिक ज्ञान
tk.protects: (पारंपरिक ज्ञान) It depends on whether the knowledge is codified in published texts or held by a community. These are different problems with different answers.
tk.inAyurveda: Codified knowledge in the authoritative texts is why many formulation patents fail: it is prior art, documented so it can be cited as such. Community-held knowledge raises a different question, about consent and about sharing what comes of it.
tk.question: Our formulation comes from a community's practice — what do we owe them?
tk.doesNot: Defensive protection stops others patenting what is already known. It gives you no exclusive right of your own, and does not substitute for the access and benefit-sharing duties below.
tk.jurisdiction: India, and internationally: a 2024 treaty addresses intellectual property, genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge, including what an applicant must disclose.

regulation.heading: बेचने से पहले क्या आवश्यक है
regulation.standfirst: वर्गीकरण पहले आता है, क्योंकि यह तय करता है कि बाकी में से कौन सा आप पर लागू होता है।

classification.title: उत्पाद वर्गीकरण
classification.body: [उत्पाद वर्गीकरण] Everything downstream follows from what your product is: a classical preparation, a patent or proprietary medicine, a new non-classical drug, a phytopharmaceutical, a food, or a cosmetic. The classification is not a label you choose — it follows from the formulation, the claim you make, and how far you have moved from an authoritative text.
classification.watchFor: Businesses often decide their route first and describe the product to fit. That is the wrong way round, and it is expensive to unwind.

licence.title: विनिर्माण लाइसेंस
licence.body: [विनिर्माण लाइसेंस] Making an Ayurvedic drug for sale requires a licence from the state licensing authority, and the licence is specific to what you make and where you make it.
licence.watchFor: A licence covering classical preparations does not automatically cover a proprietary medicine. Changing the formulation can put you outside the licence you already hold.

gmp.title: उत्पादन अभ्यास (GMP)
gmp.body: [उत्पादन अभ्यास (GMP)] Good manufacturing practice requirements for these products cover premises, equipment, staff, water, in-process checks and record-keeping. They are a condition of the licence rather than an optional standard.
gmp.watchFor: Contract manufacturing does not transfer the obligation away from the brand owner.

quality.title: गुणवत्ता और फार्माकोपिया मानक
quality.body: [गुणवत्ता और फार्माकोपिया मानक] Published pharmacopoeial monographs set identity, purity and strength standards for many single drugs and formulations, and a formulary records recognised preparations.
quality.watchFor: Where a monograph exists, meeting it is the baseline, not a marketing claim. Where none exists, you must be able to say what standard you work to and why.

labelling.title: लेबलिंग
labelling.body: [लेबलिंग] What must appear on the pack is set by more than one regime at once: drug rules, packaged-commodity rules, and — if the product is a food — the food authority's labelling regulations.
labelling.watchFor: The regimes overlap rather than nest. Satisfying one does not mean you have satisfied another.

advertising.title: विज्ञापन और दावे
advertising.body: [विज्ञापन और दावे] Advertising of these products is restricted, and certain disease claims are prohibited outright rather than merely regulated. The restriction applies to the advertisement, not only to the label.
advertising.watchFor: A claim that is prohibited on a pack is generally prohibited in a social media post as well. Enforcement follows the claim, not the medium.

food.title: खाद्य और न्यूट्रास्यूटिकल मार्ग
food.body: [खाद्य और न्यूट्रास्यूटिकल मार्ग] A product intended as a food or supplement rather than a medicine falls under the food authority, which has its own category for Ayurveda-derived foods, its own approval process, and its own limits on what a claim may say.
food.watchFor: This route is often chosen to avoid drug licensing. It brings different obligations rather than fewer, and it narrows what you may claim the product does.

cosmetic.title: प्रसाधन सामग्री मार्ग
cosmetic.body: [प्रसाधन सामग्री मार्ग] A preparation applied externally for appearance rather than therapeutic effect is regulated as a cosmetic, with its own registration and labelling requirements.
cosmetic.watchFor: The boundary is the claim. The same cream is a cosmetic or a drug depending on what you say it does.

clinicalEvidence.title: नई दवा के लिए साक्ष्य
clinicalEvidence.body: [नई दवा के लिए साक्ष्य] A formulation outside the classical texts, or one making a new therapeutic claim, moves into territory where safety and effectiveness have to be shown rather than inferred from tradition.
clinicalEvidence.watchFor: Traditional use can support some routes and not others. Which one you are on decides whether it counts.

marketAccess.title: आयात, निर्यात और बाज़ार पहुँच
marketAccess.body: [आयात, निर्यात और बाज़ार पहुँच] An Indian licence carries no weight abroad. Each destination decides for itself whether your product is a medicine, a supplement, a food or a novel ingredient, and answers that question by its own rules.
marketAccess.watchFor: The most common surprise is that the product changes category at the border, and with it the entire compliance burden.

abs.heading: पहुँच और लाभ साझाकरण
abs.standfirst: यह वह दायित्व है जो अक्सर देर से पता चलता है।
abs.whoHeading: किन पर दायित्व लागू होते हैं
abs.whoBody: दायित्व इस बात पर निर्भर करते हैं कि आप कौन हैं। भारतीय व्यक्ति, कंपनियाँ, विदेशी संस्थाएँ और शोधकर्ता अलग-अलग श्रेणियों में आते हैं।
abs.triggerBody: जैविक संसाधन या उससे जुड़े पारंपरिक ज्ञान तक अनुसंधान या व्यावसायिक उपयोग के लिए पहुँचना इसकी शुरुआत करता है।
abs.authorityBody: एक राष्ट्रीय जैव विविधता प्राधिकरण (NBA) और राज्य जैव विविधता बोर्ड (SBB) हैं।
abs.sharingHeading: लाभ साझाकरण का क्या अर्थ है
abs.sharingBody: लाभ साझाकरण हमेशा केवल नकद भुगतान नहीं होता; यह प्रौद्योगिकी हस्तांतरण या स्थानीय रोजगार भी हो सकता है।
abs.patentHeading: यह पेटेंट आवेदन से कैसे जुड़ता है
abs.patentBody: जैविक संसाधन से जुड़े पेटेंट आवेदन में स्रोत का खुलासा करना कानूनी रूप से अनिवार्य है।
abs.changeHeading: व्यवस्था में हाल ही में संशोधन हुआ है
abs.changeBody: भारतीय जैव विविधता नियमों में हाल के वर्षों में बड़े बदलाव किए गए हैं।
abs.asOfNote: यह कॉर्पस संस्करण {{version}} पर है। जब तक वास्तविक स्रोत नहीं जुड़ते, इसे मार्गदर्शन समझें।
